reviews.text: I have sensitive skin with some acne scars and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH). I bought a few other skincare products, but to help calm my skin, I decided to try these toner pads. I just started using them, and they are so good! I love that you can use them in different ways. I split each pad in two: I use the Centella side on my cheeks to soothe and calm my skin, and the Bamboo side on my forehead and chin to keep those areas hydrated. I've already started noticing a difference, which is amazing considering I've only been using them for a short time. I always use Yuka to check the skincare products I want to buy, and this one got a great score. Guys, this was definitely a good purchase!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚敏感，有啲痘印同炎症後色素沉澱（PIH）。我已經買咗幾款其他護膚品，但為咗幫皮膚舒緩，我決定試吓呢啲化妝棉。我啱啱開始用，覺得真係好好！我好鍾意可以用唔同方法嚟用。我會將每塊化妝棉分開兩半：面頰用 Centella（積雪草）嗰一面嚟舒緩同鎮靜皮膚，額頭同下巴就用 Bamboo（竹）嗰一面嚟保持呢啲位置水潤。我已經開始見到改善，考慮到我只係用咗好短時間，呢點真係好正。我買護膚品之前一定會用 Yuka 睇吓，呢款嘅分數好高。大家，呢次絕對係一個好嘅購買決定！

reviews.text: Having used the SKIN1004 soothing pads, as well as numbuzin’s number 3 (glow) and number 4 (pore) pads, I have to say that numbuzin have really knocked their formulas out of the park. Much like their other pads, these pads work beautifully. These sooth like no other- I barely have redness anymore! They’re even better than the SKIN1004! (albeit less adherent to the face). I bought a double pack, so it’ll last me a long time. I’m very very happy with my purchase.
reviews.zh: 我用過 SKIN1004 舒緩化妝棉，同埋 numbuzin 嘅 3 號（亮白）同 4 號（毛孔）化妝棉，我必須話 numbuzin 嘅配方真係做得超好。好似佢哋其他化妝棉一樣，呢款都效果好好。舒緩效果無出其右，我嘅紅位幾乎冇咗！甚至比 SKIN1004 仲好（雖然貼面嘅效果冇咁好）。我買咗雙裝，可以用好耐。我非常非常滿意呢次購買。

reviews.text:
numbuzin No.1 Centella Re-Leaf Green Toner is such a good calming toner for sensitive or irritated skin 🌿 The texture is super lightweight and watery, but it instantly makes the skin feel refreshed and hydrated without any sticky finish. It contains centella asiatica, heartleaf and licorice root extract, so it’s amazing for calming redness and helping the skin barrier feel healthier and less reactive.

I especially like using it when my skin feels irritated, overheated or after exfoliating because it gives that soothing, cooling feeling immediately. It layers really well with other skincare products and works perfectly both morning and night. If you like simple, calming skincare that makes your skin look fresh and balanced, this one is definitely worth trying ✨
reviews.zh:
numbuzin No.1 Centella Re-Leaf Green Toner 係一款好好嘅鎮靜化妝水，適合敏感或者易刺激嘅皮膚 🌿 質地超輕盈、似水咁，搽完即時令皮膚感覺清爽水潤，冇黏膩感。含有積雪草（Centella asiatica）、heartleaf 同甘草根提取物，所以對舒緩泛紅、幫助皮膚屏障感覺更健康、冇咁容易起反應，效果好好。

我特別喜歡喺皮膚覺得刺激、發熱或者去完角質之後用，因為佢可以即時帶嚟舒緩同涼爽嘅感覺。同其他護膚品疊用都好夾，早晚用都啱。如果你鍾意簡單又鎮靜嘅護膚，令皮膚睇落清新同平衡，呢款絕對值得一試 ✨

reviews.text: I wasn’t expecting too much from these toner pads but they surprised me in SUCH a good way, I literally can’t live without them anymore. There’s two sides - the white bamboo side and the green cica (centella asiastica) side. The bamboo side is hydrating and just feels really nice on the skin and the centella side is calming. It’s pretty easy to take them apart and I use them as a mask for a few minutes on areas that need calming. I was having a breakout and these helped me out so much, like Skinfood carrot carotene toner pads level. The tweezers that come with the packaging are also useful. I will definitely repurchase, I love this!!!
reviews.zh: 我本來對呢啲化妝棉冇乜期望，但佢哋以非常好嘅方式令我驚喜，我真係離唔開佢哋啦。有兩面：白色嘅竹（bamboo）面同綠色嘅 cica（積雪草，centella asiatica）面。竹面補濕，用落皮膚感覺好舒服；積雪草面就有舒緩作用。拆開兩面都幾容易，我會喺需要舒緩嘅位置當面膜敷幾分鐘。我當時有爆痘，呢啲幫咗我好多，效果好似 Skinfood carrot carotene 化妝棉咁好。包裝入面附送嘅鑷子都好實用。我一定會再買，我好鍾意！！！

reviews.text:
i have oily acne prone skin and these are a wonder!! i had this insane breakout which covered my entire face and it hurt a lot. i used these 4 times now and my face feels sm better! these (plus accutane) are actually saving me. i will definitely update on my clear skin journey.
first pic is before and second is after. my skin is far from perfect but im sure ill get there!
reviews.zh:
我係油性、易長痘嘅皮膚，呢款簡直係神奇！我之前爆咗成面嘅誇張痘痘，好痛。我已經用咗 4 次，我張面感覺好多！呢款（再加埋 accutane）真係救咗我。我一定會更新我嘅清痘旅程。
第一張相係用之前，第二張係用之後。我嘅皮膚未算好，但我相信會慢慢好返！

reviews.text: Ask someone who is learning more about the Stoner is really speaking true. I have dry skin acne and it’s very sensitive so when I try this product with just a few drops repeated on my skin my skin felt so viable when I say this I am I mean, my face did not tight at all, and it’s even felt soft 10/10 I definitely recommend it. I love it so much.
reviews.zh: 去問吓更了解 Stoner 嘅人，佢哋講嘅係真嘢。我係乾性痘痘肌，而且好敏感，所以我只係滴幾滴、重複咁塗喺皮膚上，我嘅皮膚感覺好有生氣。我講嘅係真心話，我嘅意思係，我張面一啲都冇繃緊，仲感覺柔軟。10/10，我絕對推薦，我好鍾意。

reviews.zh:
真係好好，我本身唔係好鍾意化妝水，但用咗呢款之後覺得好好，原來化妝水真係係一個重要嘅步驟。仲有，我用呢款做面膜，補濕效果真係好強，我真係講唔清咁補濕。佢都可以好容易咁舒緩泛紅同紅腫。有一次重要場合，我用咗呢款做面膜，我張面嗰種光澤，連我自己都嚇一跳，原來只係來自化妝水。嗰次我只係塗咗保濕霜、睫毛膏同唇彩就出門，已經準備好。😂
佢仲可以令皮膚變得好滑，好似 BB 霜咁，所以如果想要素顏效果，可以試吓呢個方法。
再講一次，要買呢款！佢好似有 70 片，大約可以用兩個半月，絕對係必備嘢。
另外，我個人喜歡將呢啲放入雪櫃。放咗入雪櫃之後好好用，尤其係你所在嘅地方好熱嘅話，好似我所在嘅地區咁，好熱。
仲有，有人用過呢款，但冇蓋好蓋，我外出咗，差唔多一個星期之後先發現蓋開咗。嘅確有少少乾咗，但係開咗一個星期，佢都仲係好補濕。
